publish.description: The AYN Thor's Barry Launcher settings, in tabs (LB/RB switch them): turn the bottom screen and its touch off and on, dim each screen under Steam's brightness slider, set the stick lights' dimmer; opens Barry Launcher's keyboard on the bottom screen in place of Steam's; sets melonDS, Azahar and Cemu to show their second screen there; shows, hides and orders Barry Launcher's home apps.
